description_en: Sets the region list for asset refresh and synchronization
description_zh: 设置资产刷新同步region列表
kebab_example: aliyun sas set-sync-refresh-region --vendor Tencent --region-ids eu-south-1 --default-region 0 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetSyncRefreshRegion

parameters.help_en:
The cloud asset vendor. Valid values:

Tencent: Tencent Cloud.
HUAWEICLOUD: Huawei Cloud.
Azure: Azure.
AWS: AWS
parameters.help_zh:
云资产厂商。取值：

Tencent：腾讯云
HUAWEICLOUD：华为云
Azure：Azure
AWS：AWS
parameters.name: vendor

parameters.help_en: The list of regions to be synchronized for the current site
parameters.help_zh: 当前站点需要同步的region列表
parameters.name: region_ids

parameters.help_en:
The access type of the multi-cloud site. Valid values:
0: no default site is configured, and you can select regions as needed.
1: the current site is already the default site
parameters.help_zh:
多云站点的接入类型。取值：
0：目前没有默认站点,可以正常勾选
1：当前站点已经是默认站点
parameters.name: default_region

RequestId.description_en: The unique request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
